excerpt.zh: 讽刺的是，因[malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer]对实验室器材维护过分谨慎而臭名昭著的科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，原因是个人机体长期缺乏维护。
excerpt.en: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.

texts.zh: 讽刺的是，因[malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer]对实验室器材维护过分谨慎而臭名昭著的科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]发生了致命故障，原因是个人机体长期缺乏维护。
texts.en: In a bitterly ironic twist, Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] - notorious for [malfunctioning_leader.GetHisHer] meticulous care of laboratory equipment - has suffered a critical malfunction following a prolonged lack of personal maintenance.

texts.zh: 科学官[malfunctioning_leader.GetName]在长期暴露在高度辐射性的地质样本下后发生了致命故障，因其内部辐射计数器损坏而未能察觉。
texts.en: Scientist [malfunctioning_leader.GetName] has suffered a critical malfunction after prolonged exposure to a highly radioactive geological sample, due to a faulty internal radiation meter.
